profile.headline: Software Engineer at TaxHawk, Inc.
profile.summary: Accomplished software developer and database specialist with a demonstrated history of skilled programming experience. Currently working as a Java Developer, but also skilled in ASP.net and C#, as well as database programming with COBOL and SQL. Proficient in web coding, android development, and server and database work. Strong media and communication professional currently finishing my masters' degree at Brigham Young University.
